documents: Personal statement explaining interest in the Physiology PhD
requirements.note: Undergraduate GPA usually 3.0 or higher. Program TOEFL overall 4.0 with at least 4.0 each skill; IELTS Academic 6.5 or Duolingo 105; approved English institution degree or advanced IESL exit exam may establish proficiency. A non-refundable application fee is required; amount not stated on opened central pages. Limited departmental fee waivers may be available case by case; international applicants should confirm eligibility.

funding.note: Selected IPIBS fellows receive support. Published undated IPIBS stipend $33,000, increasing to $35,000 after candidacy, tuition waiver and health insurance. Fellowship selection and continued support depend on program conditions.
